The Department of Medicine, Division of Nephrology is looking to hire a Medical Student Coordinator to support and enhance undergraduate medical education initiatives. This role coordinates fourth-year medical student electives, undergraduate clinical and research opportunities, and a variety of educational programs within the Division. The incumbent partners with faculty, learners, and university stakeholders to oversee curriculum planning, project management, course logistics, policy implementation, and program operations. Responsibilities also include coordinating orientations, scheduling, learner assessments and evaluations, and ensuring the successful delivery of medical education programs through effective communication and collaboration.
